title: Mini project: text statistics
promptMd:
Read all lines until the end of input. Print the number of lines, words (separated by whitespace), characters (not counting newlines) and the longest word (the first one if there's a tie):

```
lines 2
words 6
chars 25
longest hello
```
A final newline at the end of the input does not start a new line. Empty lines count as lines.
starterCode: # Read input with input(), print output with print().

tests.stdin:
hello world
this is a test

hints: Read line by line until there's no more input.
Splitting on whitespace handles several spaces in a row; splitting on a single space doesn't.
Only replace the longest word when a new word is strictly longer.
